title: Make the release workflow stop on failing tests instead of swallowing them with || true
description: Release-blocking: the readiness step in .github/workflows/release.yml runs make test, npm test, python -m pytest, cargo test and go test each followed by '|| true', so a failing test does not stop tagging, pushing or publishing. Acceptance for the later fix: an applicable required-check failure prevents tagging, pushing and release publication. A green dry run is not evidence that failing tests block release. Blocks any real release; does not block the 1A compatibility work. Separate from handoff 1A.
notes: One authorized dry run on 2026-10-09: run 38002436987, ref main 110bfad, inputs dry_run=true bump=auto. Result success; tag/push and GitHub Release steps skipped by their dry_run guards; remote branches, tags and releases identical before and after (git ls-remote and gh release list diffed). The readiness step printed 'No test runner detected, skipping', so the || true path was not exercised: the green dry run is not evidence that failing tests block release. Remote-write paths found: git push origin HEAD tag and gh release create, both guarded by dry_run != 'true'.

description: Worker follows the ledger rules in 005 S1.4: claim with SKIP LOCKED and a lease token, attempts counted at claim, poison rule, fenced result write, database clock, paused and held actions never claimed. Sends to the local mail sink only. Acceptance: TEST-S1-06, TEST-S1-07, TEST-S1-17 to TEST-S1-19.
notes:
ADR-03 decided (D-16): custom ledger.
